build_model_from_cfg: build a model from a config dict using build_model with optional train and test config
build_backbone_from_cfg: build a backbone network from a config dict using build_backbone
build_component_from_cfg: build a model component from a config dict using build_component
build_loss_from_cfg: build a loss module from a config dict using build_loss
build_sequential_modules: build a Sequential of modules from a list of config dicts using build
